CITY COUNCIL
  TEMPLE CITY, CALIFORNIA

  SPECIAL  MEETING  MINUTES
  February 4, 2026

1.  CALL TO ORDER

  Mayor Sternquist called the City Council Special Meeting to order  at 7:
  05  m.
  a.  in the  City  Hall

  Community Room located at 9701 Las Tunas Drive, Temple City.

2.  ROLL CALL

  PRESENT:  Councilmember —  Chavez, Chen, Yu, Man, Stemquist

  ABSENT:  Councilmember — None

  ALSO PRESENT:  City Manager Cook, Community Services  and  Public  Safety Supervisor
  Amaya, and Parking Control Officer Carrillo

  Captain Meza, Deputy Felix, Deputy Swartz

3.  PUBLIC  COMMENTS —

  Jerry Jambazian, Temple City resident, commented on the traffic enforcement  done  by deputies.

  Gary, commented  on  the high level of traffic he observed  in the City.

4.  UNFINISHED  BUSINESS — None

5.  COMMUNICATIONS

  A.  QUALITY OF LIFE

  Deputy Felix provided an overview of the sex offender registrants, paroles, and probationers
  in the City for the months of November and December 2025.

  B.  OPERATIONS

  No  report.

  C.  CRIME TRENDS

  Deputy Felix provided  an  overview of crime trends in neighboring  cities  affecting Temple City
  for the months of November and December  2025.

  D.  NOTABLE  ARRESTS

  Deputy  Felix  provided  an overview  of notable  arrests made  in the  city for the  months  of
  November and December 2025.

  E.  CRIME STATISTICS

  Deputy  Felix  provided  an  overview  of the crime statistics  for the months  of November  and

  December  2025.
